reason: I have a PNRR client asking for a funding page right now and I had to google what that even is; 120 EUR for someone who knows the programme's required format, with the first small task free so I risk nothing, is cheaper than my own afternoon of guessing. One task, that is it, and I keep the junior idea on the table.
objection: One person, 10-12 hours a week, two tasks at a time, two weeks off a year, and 24 hours to get a reply. I have already been left hanging by a freelancer before a deadline; if he goes dark with a grant deadline on my client's calendar, it is my agency's name that burns, not his.
would_change_my_mind: If the free funding page comes back late or needs rework, I never pay him a cent; if it comes back clean and on time, I would send him the contact-form-to-CRM jobs too.
